# Repo map

Structural index of `flash-theater`. **Read this to locate code** — it is regenerated from the tree, so it cannot drift.

For *how* a subsystem behaves and what has already gone wrong in it, read `findings/`. For user-facing behavior, read `docs/`, `packages/compiler/GRAMMAR.md`, and `site/` — but do not read those to learn the code.


## Entry points

| Entry | Path |
|---|---|
| CLI — `flash-theater` | `packages/compiler/bin/flash-theater.ts` |
| Script — `sideload.mjs` | `apps/environments-demo/scripts/sideload.mjs` |
| Script — `with-env.mjs` | `apps/environments-demo/scripts/with-env.mjs` |

## Areas

| Directory | Files | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| **apps/environments-demo** | | |
| `apps/environments-demo/scripts` | 2 | Node wrappers (with-env.mjs, sideload.mjs) that default FLASH_THEATER_ENV/ENVIRONMENTS_DEMO_BUILD_LABEL so compile/zip/sideload still work with zero setup — every chapter in this app reads env.*, so unlike every other demo app there is no meaningful build with no active environment |
| **packages/compiler** | | |
| `packages/compiler/bin` | 1 | flash-theater CLI executable entry point |
| `packages/compiler/src` | 9 | Package entry point, pipeline orchestration (compile.ts), CLI logic (cli.ts), and dist/ zip packaging (packaging.ts) |
| `packages/compiler/src/analysis` | 25 | BrightScript expression parsing (via flash-parser's own grammar), identifier rewriting, and the derived dependency graph |
| `packages/compiler/src/codegen` | 13 | XML/BRS emitters, generated-name conventions, and template-to-field binding analysis |
| `packages/compiler/src/dsl-parser` | 2 | AST types, plus the thin adapter from flash-parser's typed AST into this package's ThrScriptAst/ThrTemplateAst shapes |
| **packages/flash-parser** | | |
| `packages/flash-parser/src` | 27 | Lossless CST + typed AST for the whole .thr/.flsh language — the DSL's own grammar plus, as of this package's own full ownership of it, the entire BrightScript expression/statement grammar and SceneGraph XML template markup too (see xml/ below); kopytko-brightscript-parser is used only as a live catalog dependency (builtins/SceneGraph reference data) and a post-codegen validator, never for parsing |
| `packages/flash-parser/src/xml` | 4 | This package's own SceneGraph XML lexer/parser/typed-AST (XmlDocument/XmlElement/XmlAttribute) for .thr template markup — replaces the former kopytko-brightscript-parser parseXml dependency |
